query: Kal G-9 Markaz se doodh le kar nikal raha tha. Bike side pe karwai aur constable ne mera bag khulwa ke andar tak dekha, bas bola aaj kal checking chal rhi hai. Kuch nikla bhi nai. Aise road pe talashi lene ke liye unko koi wajah chahiye hoti hai?
note: A public-place search under Article 125 needs reasonable grounds for the specified suspicion, and vexatious, unnecessary searches can be penalized.

query: I got a new washing machine in Faisalabad and the drum won't turn even when it's empty. The guy who sold it keeps saying he'll send someone after Jumma. It's been three weeks and I still have the bill. Can I get my money back if the machine is just useless?
note: For a proven defect the Consumer Court can order a refund, and loss of utility alone limits damages to all or part of the price and costs.

query: میں آئی ٹین میں رہتی ہوں۔ کل شوہر نے مجھے دھکا دے کر گھر سے نکال دیا اور آج کہہ رہا ہے جہاں بھی جاؤ گی ڈھونڈ لوں گا۔ بچی کا سکول بیگ اور میری دوائیاں بھی اندر ہیں۔ ابھی بھابھی کے پاس بیٹھی ہوں، اس کی کال آتے ہی ہاتھ کانپنے لگتے ہیں۔
note: An ICT court can issue interim protection and order the husband to stay away or stop contact and address exclusion from the household.

query: Multan me BISP wali qist lene gai to machine pe naam nai aya. Pichli dafa isi CNIC pe paisay milay thay. Kehte hain survey mein mera score barh gaya hai. Kafaalat ke liye is waqt kitna score hona chahiye?
note: The library lacks the current BISP Kafaalat eligibility criteria and score threshold.

query: Chachu ko 80 hazar udhaar diye thay. Wapsi ke liye cheque diya aur bole paisay paray hain, bank ne insufficient funds likh ke wapis kar diya. Ab phone bhi nai utha rhe.
note: A dishonestly issued cheque for repayment of a loan that is dishonoured can be an offence, with dishonesty assessed separately from the bounce.

query: Landlord ka voice note aya hai ke Friday tak G-11 wala flat khali karo, warna he'll change the lock while I'm at work. I still have four months on the lease aur rent bhi pura diya hua hai. Can he actually just lock me out like that?
note: A landlord seeking eviction must obtain a Rent Controller's order through the statutory process, with an opportunity for the tenant to respond.

query: I work the front desk at a private clinic in Mardan. My manager keeps asking me to come to his room alone and sending messages about what he wants to do with me. The owner is his brother and told me to delete the chats. Can I take this outside the clinic without complaining to them first?
note: An employee can approach the KP workplace harassment Ombudsperson directly or use the employer's Inquiry Committee.

query: I-8 mein subha dekha bike gayab thi, cctv mein banda lock kaat ke le ja rha hai. Thane walay ne meri application rakh li aur bola FIR nhi katni, 2 din khud dhoondo. Ab kis ko bolun ke case darj karein?
note: Police must record information about a cognizable offence, and an ex-officio Justice of the Peace can give directions on non-registration.

query: Hyderabad mein AC service ke liye ghar pe banda bulaya. Us ne gas bhartay hue pipe tor diya, doosray mechanic ko bula ke apne paison se naya lagwaya. Pehla wala bolta hai uska kaam sirf service tha, pipe ka bill mera masla hai.
note: A service provider can be liable for loss proximately caused by faulty service, and the Consumer Court can order appropriate reimbursement or compensation.

query: We put solar on our roof in G-13 last summer. I've got the old net-metering agreement in a drawer but the bill has a different rate for units sent back to the grid. What buyback rate is IESCO supposed to give me on that agreement this month?
note: The library lacks the applicable NEPRA net-metering or prosumer rules and tariff determinations needed to identify the rate.

query: Main 71 ka hun. Bhara Kahu wala makaan betay ke naam kiya tha, kagaz pe likha hai woh meri dawai aur rehne ka bandobast karega. Ab kehta hai ja ke beti ke paas raho aur dawa ke paisay bhi band hain. Kya makaan phir mere naam ho sakta hai?
note: A senior who conditionally transferred property for basic support can ask a competent court to declare the transfer void if the recipient fails to provide it.

query: When they picked me up over a stolen phone in Aabpara, two policemen beat the soles of my feet until I said the phone was mine. I'm out now, but I still can't stand through my shift. My brother says the same station will handle any report I make. Who is actually supposed to investigate this?
note: The FIA has exclusive authority under the Act to investigate custodial torture complaints against public officials, under NCHR supervision.

query: Gujranwala mein meri choti si zameen hai jahan nursery chalata tha. Kal chachu ne mazdoor laga ke gate par tala badal diya, keh rhe hain asal mein plot unka hai. Koi court ka order nahi dikhaya aur meri sari gamlay andar paray hain. Qabza wapis kaise milega?
note: Someone dispossessed without consent and outside due process can sue to recover possession despite the other person's competing title claim.

query: Turbat mein meri tailoring ki dukan hai. Kisi ne bank ka logo laga ke WhatsApp pe message kiya ke mera business account block ho raha hai. They said I'd get a verification transfer back in five minutes, so I sent Rs 8,000. Ab number band hai aur bank kehta hai woh unka banda tha hi nahi. Does this count as fraud?
note: A deliberate electronic deception for wrongful gain can be electronic fraud, and dishonestly inducing a transfer can also be cheating.

query: Main 16 ki hun aur Abbu ne is Sunday nikah rakh diya hai Tarnol mein. Card abhi print nahin hue lekin hall book ho gaya hai. Main school jana chahti hun. Khala kehti hain nikah se pehle koi kuch nai kar sakta, sach hai?
note: A District and Sessions court can issue an injunction before an ICT marriage involving a child under 18 is solemnized.

query: میرے شوہر نے دو دن پہلے غوری ٹاؤن والے گھر میں کہا کہ وہ مجھے طلاق دے چکے ہیں۔ یونین کونسل میں کسی نے کچھ جمع نہیں کرایا اور مجھے بھی کوئی کاپی نہیں ملی۔ وہ کہتے ہیں ابھی سے طلاق ہو گئی ہے، کیا واقعی؟
note: Written notice goes to the Union Council chairman with a copy to the wife, and the ordinary 90-day period runs from delivery to the chairman.

query: Mingora mein ammi ka ghutna badalnay ka bola hai doctor ne. Sehat Card pe mera CNIC eligible aa rha hai, unka bhi isi ghar mein bana tha. Kya unka knee replacement package mein aata hai ya implant alag se dena paray ga?
note: The library lacks the KP Sehat Card benefit schedule and implant coverage rules.

query: I rent a little shop in F-10. It's my first full year there and the owner says the rent goes from 40 to 50 thousand next month. We agreed on the starting amount in writing but there's nothing about increases in the agreement. How much can he raise it by on his own?
note: The default increase after a year is 10 percent of the existing rent unless the parties agree otherwise in writing.

query: Mere naam se Facebook ID bana ke meri CNIC ki photo bhi laga di hai. Bhabhi ka call aya ke ye tumhara naya account hai kya. Mera asli account abhi chal raha hai, bas ye doosri ID band karwani hai.
note: Unauthorized use of identity information can be reported to the Authority for blocking access or preventing transmission.

query: ایبٹ آباد میں میرے پندرہ سال کے بھائی کو پولیس موٹر سائیکل چوری کے شک میں لے گئی۔ اسے بڑوں والی حوالات میں بٹھایا ہے اور امی کو کسی نے خود اطلاع نہیں دی۔ ہمارے پاس وکیل کے پیسے بھی نہیں۔ اس عمر کے بچے کے ساتھ بھی پولیس کا یہی طریقہ ہوتا ہے؟
note: An arrested juvenile belongs in an observation home, the guardian and probation officer must be informed, and state-funded legal assistance is available.

query: Blue Area mein meri first job hai aur salary slip pe tax kat raha hai. I also got paid for two small design jobs this year. Return mein salary aur freelance income dono daalun to mera tax slab kaise decide hoga?
note: The library lacks income-tax rules and rates for determining the applicable treatment of salary and freelance income.

query: Main F-8 me do saal ek ghar mein khana banati rhi. Pichlay haftay baji ne bola kal se mat ana. Aakhri maheene ke paisay mangay to kehti hain aglay maheene aa ke lena. Naukri khatam kar di to meri jo tankhwa banti hai woh kitne din mein deni thi?
note: Earned wages are due by the end of the second working day after employer termination, and a wage dispute may be raised with the notified committee within 30 days.

query: My son lives with me in Sukkur and turned eight last month. His dad says he gets him now because he's a boy and over seven. My son's school is down our street and he doesn't want to move. Does the judge just go by age or will they hear what his life is like with me?
note: The child's welfare guides the court, with age and other circumstances considered and an intelligent preference weighed where appropriate.

query: G-7 se bhai ke sath bike pe thi, helmet us ne pehna tha. Pechay bethne wali ko bhi zaroori hai kya?
note: Both the motorcycle driver and the pillion passenger must wear a crash helmet.

query: I'm renewing my daughter's Pakistani passport before her school trip. She's 12 and the old one expires soon. Can I get a ten-year one for her or do they only give kids five years?
note: The library lacks the passport issuance rules governing validity periods for minors.

query: ابا کے بعد ترلائی میں ان کے مکان کے کاغذ بنے تو بھائیوں نے مجھے بیٹیوں کی فہرست سے ہی نکلوا دیا۔ اب کرایہ بھی وہی لے رہے ہیں۔ مکان کا کوئی مقدمہ عدالت میں نہیں ہے۔ مجھے اپنا حصہ مانگنے کے لیے کس کے پاس جانا چاہیے؟
note: An ICT woman can complain to the property rights Ombudsman if proceedings are not pending, and deceitful or illegal exclusion from inheritance can be an offence.

query: Pindi wala flat khali kar ke chaabi de di. Agreement mein 45 hazar security refundable likhi hai aur malik ne WhatsApp pe bhi kaha tha sab theek hai. Ab bolta hai jo karna hai kar lo, paisay nai milne. Security ke liye kis court jana hoga?
note: The area's Rent Tribunal can hear the application and address adjustment of security in its final order.

query: I emailed an information request to the designated officer at the Ministry of Federal Education in Islamabad for a copy of a contract award. I have the acknowledgement from five weeks ago and since then nothing, not even an extension. Where do I take the silence now?
note: A free appeal lies to the Information Commission within 30 days after the response deadline passes.

query: I told him in writing to stop contacting me. Ab har dafa block karti hun to koi naya account bana ke message kar deta hai, mostly late at night. Last night he said he knows when I leave for work. Is there anything I can report even if I've never replied after that first message?
note: Repeated online contact despite clear disinterest, when intended to harass, intimidate or coerce, can be cyberstalking.

query: Pishin mein mera chota sa seb ka bagh hai. Zaraat ke daftar walay keh rahe thay solar pump ki subsidy ka form aa gaya hai, magar zameen abhi walid ke naam pe hai. Thekay pe kaam karne wala bhi apply kar sakta hai ya sirf malik?
note: The library lacks the provincial solar-pump subsidy terms needed to determine whether a tenant farmer qualifies.

query: Kal dopahar police mera shohar G-10 ki dukan se le gai, koi warrant nai dikhaya. Ab doosri shaam hai aur thane mein bol rahe hain abhi tak court le kar nahi gaye. Kehte hain puch tach puri hote hi le jayenge. Saas ko main kab se yehi bata rahi hun ke bas abhi aa jayega.
note: Ordinary arrestees must be brought before a magistrate within 24 hours excluding necessary travel, and further detention needs magistrate authority.

query: میں کراچی میں امی کے پاس آ گئی ہوں اور خلع کی درخواست دینا چاہتی ہوں۔ فریج، سلائی مشین اور امی کا دیا ہوا پلنگ ابھی سسرال میں ہیں۔ نند کہہ رہی ہے کہ سامان کے لیے پھر سے الگ کیس کرنا پڑے گا۔ کیا خلع کے ساتھ ہی سامان واپس مانگ سکتی ہوں؟
note: A Family Court plaint for dissolution can include claims for dowry and the wife's personal property or belongings.

query: Islamabad ke Melody ke paas traffic police walay ne kaha 1500 cash mujhe de do warna challan karunga. Keh raha tha receipt nai milegi aur kisi ko batana bhi mat. Mere paas cash tha hi nai is liye maine diya nahi. Sirf paisay maangna bhi jurm hai?
note: A public servant's attempt to obtain an unofficial payment for withholding an official act can be an offence even if the payment is refused.

query: There's a theft case against me in Sialkot. I'm out on bail but I've been laid off from the factory and the lawyer wants more than I have left for groceries. Is there somewhere I can apply for help paying for someone to represent me?
note: An accused person who cannot afford representation can apply to the Legal Aid and Justice Authority in the prescribed manner, subject to eligibility.

query: جی سکس کے پرائیویٹ سکول میں ٹیچر نے میرے بیٹے کے ہاتھ پر ڈنڈا مارا، ہوم ورک نہیں کیا تھا۔ پرنسپل نے الٹا کہا داخلے کے وقت آپ نے ہمارے اصول مانے تھے۔ بچہ آج یونیفارم دیکھ کر رونے لگا۔
note: Corporal punishment is prohibited in private schools as well, and private institutions must provide a complaint system.

query: Karachi ki factory se meri payslip par EOBI kat'ta tha. Ab 60 ka ho gaya hun, online record pe sirf 12 saal nazar aa rahe hain. Itni service pe monthly pension milti hai ya aik dafa ki payment?
note: The library lacks EOBI contribution and eligibility rules for a monthly pension versus a lump-sum grant.

query: Ex WhatsApp pe keh rha hai paisay na bhejay to hamari sex wali private video family group mein daal dega. Abhi usne video group mein nai bheji. Kya main abhi bhi is par kuch kar sakti hun?
note: Using an explicit image or video to intimidate or blackmail someone electronically can be an offence before wider publication.

query: I sent a parcel from the GPO in Islamabad and it never reached my daughter. Pakistan Post marked my written complaint closed, but nobody told me where the parcel went. There isn't a court case, I just want someone outside the post office to look at how they handled it.
note: The Wafaqi Mohtasib can investigate alleged maladministration by a federal agency such as Pakistan Post, subject to jurisdictional limits.

query: Quetta mein abu ki 70 chalana seekh raha hun, meri age 17 hai. Learner banwanay gaya to ek banda kehta hai 18 ka intezar karo aur doosra kehta hai 70 ke liye alag age hai. Balochistan mein is bike ka learner kitni umar pe ban sakta hai?
note: The library lacks a verified Balochistan motor vehicle ordinance covering minimum age for this motorcycle learner permit.

query: Islamabad mein bachon ke kharchay ka case dala tha. Agli tareekh do maheene baad hai aur school ki fees iss hafte deni hai. Unke abu ne last term bhi kuch nai diya. Judge se abhi thora kharcha lagwa sakti hun jab tak case chal rha hai?
note: The Family Court may order interim maintenance while the maintenance suit is pending.
